mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the spring-tide prediction at the shore was the strongest moment: a concrete expectation met observation, with a clear limit on what agreement proves.

leastWorthwhile.text: Several intermediate results were brief, particularly Story and Constellations, leaving their connection to the wider inquiry somewhat thin.

surprise.text: The clarification that spring tide means a larger tidal range, not a seasonal tide, was useful and unexpected.

arbitrary.text: Language plus memory producing Story was plausible, but its purpose in testing the lunar hypothesis was unclear until the star-pattern path unfolded.

continue.text: Yes. The move from making a world to letting its inhabitants test and share ideas offers an appealing direction, although the mostly single-option sequence left few meaningful choices.
